purpose: Mandatory pre-historical full-shape nonhistorical compute qualification. PASS is required before CONTROLLED-EXECUTION BOUNDARY may authorize any historical attempt marker.

environment.parallelism_rule: Implementation may use deterministic process-level parallelism across independent frozen configs/tracks only. Each worker inherits one-thread BLAS/OpenMP caps; result ordering is canonical and scheduling cannot alter seeds or reductions.
environment.runner_image_policy: Qualification and historical execution must both use the explicit ubuntu-24.04 label; exact ephemeral runner image versions are recorded in evidence but patch-image drift alone is not scientific drift if pinned Python/dependencies and equivalence checks pass.

synthetic_generator.construction: Deterministic synthetic OHLCV plus deterministic nondegenerate synthetic qualification labels/matrices. Synthetic OHLCV exercises event and feature builders; workload labels are independently generated from the frozen seed to guarantee all 40 tracks, every refit, every config, and nondegenerate class support without using historical values.
synthetic_generator.feature_stress: At least 12 correlated latent factors, mixed scales, heavy-tailed deterministic innovations clipped at finite bounds, 5% deterministic missingness outside rows required to preserve valid training columns; no all-missing required column.
synthetic_generator.label_stress: All 40 tracks have deterministic prevalence between 0.10 and 0.30 in every qualification refit training history and both classes in every scored prediction block. No config/track may be skipped for low support.

pass_rule: PASS only if zero historical/network reads, exact shape/counts, reference equivalence, deterministic environment, total wall-clock <=10800s, peak process-tree RSS <=4GiB and <=60% MemTotal, no swap/OOM, and every required evidence field is present.
failure_rule: Any violation is QUALIFICATION_FAIL. No controlled historical boundary, RUN_ATTEMPT.marker, historical payload read, or scientific execution is authorized. Synthetic qualification may be repeated after semantic-preserving engineering remediation.
anti_rescue: Increasing historical timeout, dropping architectures/configs/refits/bootstrap/PBO, changing solver semantics/tolerances, or approximating scientific calculations cannot convert a qualification failure to PASS.
